name: Assured Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies which type of party should be the assured on the insurance certificate.

BUYE.name: Buyer
BUYE.definition: The buyer should be the assured.

SELL.name: Seller
SELL.definition: The seller should be the assured.

BUBA.name: Buyer Bank
BUBA.definition: The buyer's bank should be the assured.

SEBA.name: Seller Bank
SEBA.definition: The seller's bank should be the assured.
